body_lead: HYDERABAD: Government school students across Telangana will have access to an AI-based learning tool aimed at improving language and mathematical skills from the 2026-27 academic year. The School Education department, in collaboration with the EkStep Foundation, is set to expand the AI-based Foundational Literacy and Numeracy (FLN) programme in Mathematics and Telugu to over 5,000 government schools across the state.
